title: Why developers are ditching GitHub for Codeberg and self-hosting alternatives
summary: This article explores the growing trend of developers migrating from GitHub to decentralized alternatives like Codeberg and self-hosted solutions, driven by concerns over corporate control, proprietary lock-in, and the desire for community-driven, non-profit code hosting platforms.
problem_solved: Addresses developer concerns about dependence on centralized, commercially-controlled code hosting platforms and lack of platform independence.
why_valuable: Provides developers with visibility into viable open-source alternatives to major git hosting platforms, enabling informed decisions about where to host their code projects.
